data.one_liner: Testing utilities for Flutter hooks that avoid writing wrapper widgets.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to test custom Flutter hooks directly without having to construct a dedicated test widget. It provides utilities for updating inputs, retrieving outputs, and handling asynchronous updates.
use_when: You are writing a library with one or more custom hooks not directly tied to a widget
You have a complex hook that is difficult to test through widget interactions
avoid_when: Your hook is defined alongside a widget and is only used there
Your hook is easy to test by just testing the widgets using it
strengths: Simplifies custom hook testing without requiring manual widget boilerplate
Provides async waiting utilities like waitFor and waitForNextUpdate
Supports wrappers to supply providers to hooks
weaknesses: Not necessary if your hooks are simple and tested purely via widget tests

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pack_it: Standard Dart unit testing framework if you are not testing Flutter-specific UI/hooks.
